checks.detail: All five root-finalized inputs matched their supplied SHA-256 bindings before review.
Distinct output-creation and raw-root exceptions keep pre-existing output fail-closed while allowing recovery only after this invocation created a usable output directory.
A catchable raw-root creation failure with usable output reaches exactly one terminal publication and returns FAIL with zero executions and an empty execution-record list after publication succeeds.
Terminal publication remains atomic and create-once; terminal I/O failure is unwrapped and propagated without returning a result that claims preserved evidence.
Later exceptions still require an existing raw root, reconstruct ordered evidence when possible, and follow the unchanged terminalization path.

The authority, config, evaluator, tests, and preflight agree; source and test line caps, canonical one-line config, 29-line churn cap, direct regression, focused checks, and two 152-test full-suite passes are recorded.
